## IExtractorLibConfig.bundledPackages property

Packages to treat as bundled (their types will be inlined). Array of package names, e.g., `['lodash', '\@types/node']`

**Signature:**

```typescript
bundledPackages?: string[];
```

## Remarks

When a package is marked as bundled, API Extractor will inline its types into the rollup rather than importing them. This is useful when you bundle dependencies and want their types to be part of your public API.
